findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_game, get_entity, list_games, get_game, generate_sounds, generate_music, set_game_visibility, save_sound, suggest_game_setup · Private data: find_sounds, set_game_visibility, save_sound, export_game, get_manifest, godot_plugin, approve_spending · Public sink: create_game, create_tracks, share_sound · Destructive: choose_sound, delete_sound, export_game, get_manifest, godot_plugin.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_game, get_entity, list_games, get_game, generate_sounds, generate_music, set_game_visibility, save_sound, suggest_game_setup · Private data: find_sounds, set_game_visibility, save_sound, export_game, get_manifest, godot_plugin, approve_spending · Public sink: create_game, create_tracks, share_sound · Destructive: choose_sound, delete_sound, export_game, get_manifest, godot_plugin

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
